purpose: Epoch ranges that have validation-loss evidence but no per-epoch diagnostics, each with the reason the producer was absent. build_metrics_catalog.py still fails on any gap that is not declared here; a declaration makes the gap visible, it does not excuse it.

gaps.reason: The RTX 3090 diagnostics pod ended between epoch 78 and 79 on 2026-08-12 while the L40S kept training to 114. A replacement 3090 replayed dicos-f-02's retained queue on 2026-08-13, closing epochs 79-90 and measuring the accepted best. The replay was stopped before dicos-f-03's queue because those epochs did not improve on epoch 90 and the owner asked for compute to stop.
gaps.consequence: The accepted best, dicos-f-02 epoch 90, IS measured; this gap no longer touches checkpoint selection. What remains unmeasured is the tail that failed to improve on it, so the distribution-metric trend cannot be extended past epoch 90.
gaps.closes_when: A diagnostics pod drains _diag/dicos-f-03/queue, which still holds all 24 checkpoints, and the metrics are imported through scripts/refresh_continuation_outputs.py.
